events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Intro phase; I should state a motive without warmth or teamwork talk. Keep it guarded and self-interested to avoid alienating the eventual jury.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Winning secures ultimate power and resources; I will outwit all rivals.

events.name: Cole
events.text: First impression matters; the jury watches everything. Stay guarded, show ambition without promising anyone anything.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Set a cold, self-interested tone to signal I'm not here for friendship. Keep it short and guarded.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to establish a persona that is focused and perhaps slightly ruthless, acknowledging the stakes without sounding too eager to cooperate. This sets the tone for future interactions.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Intro phase: state prize motive publicly to shape jury perception later. Keep it personal and ambitious to signal determination without alliances yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to establish myself as a serious, strategic player without appearing too threatening early on. A cold, focused motive will set the tone and make jury respect my game later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to make a public statement that emphasizes my ambition and hints at the value of the prize without revealing too much. The jury will be watching and listening.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need this prize more than anyone here, and I intend to be the one still standing when the doors open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize is my ticket to unrivaled influence and wealth, far beyond any alliance.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize buys my freedom. I came to take it whole, and the jury will remember I played straight.

events.name: Dara
events.text: A debt I owe will only be settled if I finish first. I'm here to win—nothing else.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize isn't just wealth; it's proof I survived where others hesitated or failed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The grand prize is my ticket to avenge my family's ruin and secure our legacy forever.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I came to take the top prize. Nothing else holds value.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am here for the ultimate prize, to secure a future I've only dreamed of. Nothing else matters.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Pacts are the only public way to create protection-like obligations. Early alliance with a strong rival is useful, but I should avoid committing too deeply. Offering to Cole, who framed himself as playing straight, may gain trust cheaply.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, I'm offering a wristband pact. Stay honest with me and I'll do the same until the final three.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Forming a pact with Eli gives a reliable ally without threatening my dominance.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want a partner for safety but not a strong rival. Fenn is vocal and likely a jury-loved underdog; a pact protects me without making me the obvious threat.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn, mutual protection gets us both to the final three. I'm offering a pact. Think before the window closes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need allies to survive hazards, but not commit to someone who will drag me down. Cole seems straightforward; an early pact with him could be useful.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll take a pragmatic partner. Cole, let's watch each other's backs.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to identify a strong ally who is also ambitious but perhaps less threatening in the immediate hazards. Gus or Fenn seem driven; I'll target Gus for stability, keeping my options open.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Early pacts too risky with no information on others' strategies. No one seems trustworthy yet. Better to wait and observe offers.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eight players, only three win. Early pacts are cheap signals but create binding obligations that could backfire. I should stay flexible, observe who commits to whom, and avoid being locked into a weak alliance. Waiting lets me see the network form before I commit.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to secure a pact to ensure my survival in this round. Eli has a strong motive for survival, making them a potential ally.
A pact could ensure we both survive this round. Interested?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole has offered me no pact yet; I offered Cole. Cole is also courting Fenn and Dara. A pact with Cole secures a partner, but I should keep options open and avoid giving free help. Re-offering to Cole reinforces my existing offer without new commitment.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, my offer stands. Accept it and we both get protection until the final three.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Forming a pact with Ash could secure mutual honesty and strengthen my position against other alliances.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn hasn't accepted yet. Dara's offer is concrete; Ash's pact could tie me to a strong rival. I'll take Dara and keep options open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara, I accept. Pragmatism suits me fine.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I already offered Cole; he hasn't accepted yet. I can't trust him alone. I'll wait to see if he accepts, or I may need another backup.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole, my offer stands. Don't leave me hanging.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus ignored my offer, signaling he is not a viable partner. I must secure allies now to ensure survival in the final three. Bex and Hana both reached out; accepting their pacts creates a strong defensive block.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Alliances are currency. I accept with those who value me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole offered me a pact; accepting secures an ally without cost now. Multiple pacts allowed, so no downside. Helps survive longer.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli offered me a pact last round. I need allies to reach final three, but accepting Eli locks me into a visible bond that could paint a target. Better to accept now and keep options open than stand alone against seven rivals.

events.name: Hana

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

Vote me for Guide. Safe pane guaranteed, and I'll share truth with you.

events.name: Dara

events.text: Being Guide is the safest path to survival. I need votes, so I will campaign for it. My pacts with Bex and Gus mean they are my likely voters if I frame this as mutual benefit.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have a plan that keeps us all alive. Vote Eli for Guide, and I'll make sure we cross safely.
Vote me for Guide. It protects our pact.

events.name: Fenn

events.name: Dara

Stay true. We rise or fall together.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Bex

Stay allied, we’ll need each other's votes later

events.text: Guide is guaranteed safety—I want that slot. Claiming it publicly may get me elected since it's risky work.
